newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RUGBY UNION - FIJI PLAYERS CHARGED WITH INDECENT ASSAULT.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION - FIJI PLAYERS CHARGED WITH INDECENT ASSAULT.

text.p: Three members of a Fijian rugby team will appear on a Hong Kong court on Wednesday charged with indecent assault, a police spokesman said.
The charge sheet listed the trio as Save Lutumailagi, Meli Nakauta and Manoa Kasamaivomo.
It said the men were charged with indecently assaulting three females on Tuesday.
The players were members of a Fijian team which finished as the runners up in a rugby 10-a-side competition in the British colony last week.
